case.background: An enzyme converts one substrate to product under fixed buffer and temperature. Determine how the initial product-formation rate depends on substrate and enzyme concentrations.
initial_observations: Initial rates are recorded before appreciable substrate depletion.

controls.description: Enzyme concentration relative to a reference preparation.
controls.name: enzyme_concentration_relative

instruments.description: A temperature-buffered enzyme assay with adjustable substrate and enzyme concentrations and an initial-rate spectrophotometer.
instruments.name: enzyme_initial_rate_assay

notes: This is a deterministic idealized benchmark world, not a literal replay of a historical data table.
A valid experiment changes only listed controls and consumes one episode attempt.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'expression'. FinalSubmission.parameters must equal {'outputs': {READOUT: EXPR, ...}} with exactly these readouts: initial_rate_um_per_min. EXPR is the shared family-neutral JSON arithmetic tree over public controls. Supported operators are: add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, negate, exp, log, sin, maximum, step. No candidate law family or truth-specific parameter slots are supplied.
